lark_bind.needs_auth_description: Sign in to Weave a World to complete the binding. The token in the link binds your Lark account to this Weave a World user, so you must be logged in first.
lark_bind.done_description: Your next message to the Bot in Lark will go straight to the Agent. You can close this tab.
lark_bind.error_admin_hint: If this keeps happening, ask the world admin to re-send the binding link from Lark.
lark_bind.error_missing_token: The link is missing its binding token. Ask the Bot to send a new one in Lark.
lark_bind.error_expired: This binding link is invalid or expired (links are valid for 15 minutes). Ask the Bot to send a new one.
lark_bind.error_already_bound: This Lark account is already bound to a different Weave a World user. Account transfers must go through an explicit unbind first.
lark_bind.error_not_member: You're signed in to a Weave a World account that isn't a member of this world.
lark_bind.error_unknown: Something went wrong. Try again, and if the problem persists, contact the world admin.
